import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
def base(p): return p[0]/t+p[1]*np.log(1+p[2]*t)*A**2
r0=least_squares(lambda p: base(p)-y,[9.4,1.5,-0.04],bounds=([-100,-100,-0.09],[100,100,5]))
res=y-base(r0.x)
G={'A':A,'1/A':1/A,'A2':A**2,'logA':np.log(A),'sqrtA':np.sqrt(A),'expA':np.exp(-A),'1':np.ones_like(A),'A3':A**3}
H={'t':t,'t2':t**2,'sqrt':np.sqrt(t),'log':np.log(t),'inv':1/t,'t3':t**3,'1':np.ones_like(t),'expt':np.exp(-t),'exp-.3':np.exp(-0.3*t),'exp.3':np.exp(0.3*t),'sin':np.sin(t),'cos':np.cos(t)}
out=[]
for gn,g in G.items():
  for hn,h in H.items():
    f=h*g
    c=np.dot(f,res)/np.dot(f,f)
    sc=np.mean((res-c*f)**2)/np.var(y)
    out.append((round(sc,5),gn,hn,round(c,4)))
out.sort()
for o in out[:6]: print(o)
print('base', np.mean(res**2)/np.var(y))
